name: Click Buffer
description: Remembers a click made too early and replays it a few frames later, when you land. Adjustable from the pause menu.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the click buffer on or off.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Frames
buffer-frames.description: How many frames early a click can be and still be replayed when you land. 0 turns the buffer off.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Show a very small red face in the corner of the screen while the mod is active.
